items.title: Smulyan interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I was playing with Kenny Warner, Billy Drews, I mean we used to have like a horn section with five horns.

ctx.x: Sure. That’s funny. You do what’s required.

Well you know I think that colleges, as part of jazz education should teach these young musicians how to play a gig like that. I think that would be really valuable. Because you get out of school and I mean I used to do four or five — you know we’d call them club dates. Some people call them casuals. I think it depends on what part of the country you come from. But it’s a wedding or a bar mitzvah basically. And you know sometimes I would do five of those on a weekend. You know, two on Friday, two on Saturday — no…
